## Appearance

Aunt Euphemia is a small, elderly woman with a diminutive, gently triangular face featuring rose-colored cheeks and big, tender blue eyes that hold an irrepressible youthfulness. Her silver-white hair is styled in charming, small rolls positioned above her ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is a good-humoured woman with laughing eyes who considers [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) to be completely insane. She is easily won over by constant and respectful manners, though she harbors a deep dread of the serpents reported to exist in [India](../codex/places.md#india).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Nell-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025), [v3 ch.Speaks P9](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0009), [v3 ch.Rowena P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

## History

Aunt Euphemia grew up in a family with around six girls and was named Jamesina after her father, who drowned at sea a month before her birth. Throughout her life, she was forbidden by both her mother and her husband from owning a yellow silk dress. Before allowing her daughter to study mathematics with a university professor, Aunt Euphemia personally taught her how to cook. In her youth, she made a habit of deriding her own suitors, once advising one suitor to wear an elastic strip to flatten his ears. Over time, she received a cat named [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) as a gift from her laundress. She eventually moved into Tabby's Place with her two cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), reassuring the young women living there that she would not strictly supervise them. As the group settled into their household routine, the girls later teased her about her history with past suitors.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +11 more_

## Quotes

> “I do not think the Devil could be quite so unattractive,” Aunt Euphemia remarked thoughtfully. “He would fail to cause as much damage were that the case. My impression of him has always been that of an attractive gentleman.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Relationships P71](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0071)

> "Well, Nell, I do hope that is true, since I am in love with her. However, I fail to comprehend her—she completely baffles me. She differs from every girl I have ever known, as well as every girl that I used to be."
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Indeed, within my spirit. However, I must concede that my legs lack the youth of your own. Head outside to catch some fresh air, Nell. Your complexion has appeared pale recently."
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> “Go out and breathe some fresh air,” Aunt Euphemia reiterated, “yet carry your umbrella with you, because I think rain is coming. My leg has rheumatism.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P8](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0008)

> “Oh, men—yes. However, it was of ministers that I was speaking, my dear,” Aunt Euphemia said in a rebuking manner. “Furthermore, you ought not to flirt in that way with Mr. Hale—you truly ought not to.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P15](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0015)

## Relationships

### [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--cressy-lindsay.md)

Aunt Euphemia lives together with [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) and the other girls at Tabby's Place, bringing her cats [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) to join the household. Upon arriving, Aunt Euphemia assures the group that she will not strictly supervise them, creating a relaxed living dynamic. She occasionally chats with [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) about potential suitors and marriage before [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) heads out to social events.

### [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--honora-hollis.md)

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--nell-harcourt.md)

Aunt Euphemia is a friend, housemate, and affectionate elder figure to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at Tabby's Place.
